# Startwell Education

> Startwell Education is a school in Bhimber, Azad Jammu & Kashmir, Pakistan, offering education from Playgroup to Matric (Class 10). It also runs free online tools for students and a free programming course in Roman Urdu (C++ and Databases).

Contact: +92 340 1501700. Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Website: https://www.startwell.edu.pk/

## Blog

- [Blog](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/blog): Research-based articles for parents.
- [Education in Pakistan in Numbers: What the Latest Data Shows](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/blog/education-statistics-pakistan): Key education statistics for Pakistan: institutions, students, private school share, enrolment and out-of-school children, with global context from UNESCO 2026.
- [Out-of-School Children in Pakistan: What the Data Says](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/blog/out-of-school-children-pakistan): 26.2 million children were out of school in Pakistan in 2021–22 (39%). See the numbers by level, wealth and distance, plus global data from UNESCO 2026.
- [Private Schools in Pakistan: Why Nearly Half of Students Attend Them](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/blog/private-schools-pakistan-statistics): Nearly half of Pakistan’s students attend private schools. See the 2021–22 figures, UNESCO’s 2026 data, and what parents should check before choosing one.
- [Why Early Years Education Matters: Evidence from Pakistan and the World](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/blog/early-years-education-pakistan): Why early childhood education matters: evidence from UNESCO’s 2026 report, pre-primary enrolment in Pakistan, and what good early years look like.
- [Choosing a School in Bhimber: Facilities, Distance and Class Size](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/blog/choosing-school-bhimber-facilities): How to choose a school in Bhimber, AJK: check facilities, distance and class size, with national and AJK school-facility data from 2021–22.
- [ASER Pakistan 2025: What Children Can Read and Do](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/blog/aser-2025-pakistan-findings): Key findings from ASER Pakistan 2025: out-of-school rate, what Class 3 and Class 5 children can read and do, and how government and private schools compare.
- [How Well Do Children Learn in Rural AJK? ASER 2025 Findings](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/blog/aser-2025-ajk-learning): How well do children in rural Azad Jammu & Kashmir read and do maths? ASER 2025 results by class, compared with the national average.
- [Government vs Private Schools in Rural AJK: Facilities and Teachers](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/blog/ajk-government-private-schools-aser-2025): ASER 2025 compares rural AJK government and private schools: electricity, water, toilets, playgrounds, libraries, labs and teacher qualifications.
- [Early Childhood Education in Pakistan and AJK: What Parents Should Know](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/blog/early-childhood-education-aser-2025): How many Pakistani children aged 3–5 attend early childhood education? ASER 2025 and national statistics, plus what AJK schools offer.


## Free tools for students

- [Free Student Tools](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/tools): Overview of all free tools. No sign-up, no ads, files stay on the user's device.
- [PDF Toolbox](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/pdf-toolbox): Edit, merge, split and rotate PDFs, convert photos to PDF, add page numbers and watermarks.
- [Image Resizer](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/image-resizer): Reduce photo size in KB and resize dimensions for forms.
- [Marks Calculator](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/marks-calculator): Total, percentage, grade and pass/fail for each subject.
- [Word Counter](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/word-counter): Count words and characters in English and Urdu, with word limit and reading time.

## Free programming course in Roman Urdu

- [Programming](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/programming): Overview of the free course: Programming Fundamentals (PF), OOP and Databases.
- [PF Bilkul Aasan](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/pf-bilkul-aasan): Programming Fundamentals chapters with runnable examples.
- [OOP Bilkul Aasan](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-bilkul-aasan): Object-Oriented Programming chapters with runnable examples.
- [OOP Lectures](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lectures): 12 interactive lectures with quizzes.
- [OOP Lecture 1: Introduction aur Objects](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lecture-introduction-objects): Real-life and industry examples, C++ code and a quiz.
- [OOP Lecture 2: Encapsulation aur Interface](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lecture-encapsulation-interface): Real-life and industry examples, C++ code and a quiz.
- [OOP Lecture 3: Abstraction, Class, Inheritance](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lecture-abstraction-class-inheritance): Real-life and industry examples, C++ code and a quiz.
- [OOP Lecture 4: Inheritance ke Concepts](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lecture-inheritance-concepts): Real-life and industry examples, C++ code and a quiz.
- [OOP Lecture 5: Association, Composition, Aggregation](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lecture-association-composition-aggregation): Real-life and industry examples, C++ code and a quiz.
- [OOP Lecture 6: Polymorphism](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lecture-polymorphism): Real-life and industry examples, C++ code and a quiz.
- [OOP Lecture 7: C++ me Class](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lecture-class-in-cpp): Real-life and industry examples, C++ code and a quiz.
- [OOP Lecture 8: Constructor](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lecture-constructor): Real-life and industry examples, C++ code and a quiz.
- [OOP Lecture 9: Copy Constructor, Destructor, this](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lecture-copy-constructor-destructor-this): Real-life and industry examples, C++ code and a quiz.
- [OOP Lecture 10: this Pointer aur const Functions](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lecture-this-pointer-const-functions): Real-life and industry examples, C++ code and a quiz.
- [OOP Lecture 11: const, Initializer List, static](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lecture-const-initializer-list-static): Real-life and industry examples, C++ code and a quiz.
- [OOP Lecture 12: static Functions aur Array of Objects](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/oop-lecture-static-functions-array-of-objects): Real-life and industry examples, C++ code and a quiz.
- [C++ Compiler](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/compiler): Free online C++ compiler with lesson programs.
- [Database Level 1: Bilkul Aasan](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/database-bilkul-aasan): 12 database lectures with live SQL practice in the browser.
- [Database Level 2: Industrial](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/database-industrial): 8 real production database problems, interview questions and a mock interview.
- [Database Level 3: Big Tech and Docker](https://www.startwell.edu.pk/database-big-tech): Docker, SQL interview rounds, system design, replication, MongoDB, Redis and PostgreSQL.
